LOCK EVERYTHING ELSE: all portraits and panels at the top, HP and SAN continuous bars and numbers, turn counter and pause/settings at top right, paper adventure log, narrow prompt strip above buttons, the three tilted piles, every hand card including native 392:590 shape and printed card typography, background cavern, skulls, rocks, scrolls, foreground tentacles, overall brightness and color grading. Preserve all pixels outside the three button region as closely as possible.
Only the bottom-right buttons are being explored. Preserve teal/blue-green for skill, subdued warm umber for rest, and deep muted oxblood for end turn, rather than making all buttons gold.
VERSION A, conservative typography and spacing repair: KEEP THE EXISTING OUTER BUTTON SILHOUETTES AND TENTACLE-ATTACHED ANTIQUE METAL FRAMES. The current copy is too tiny and frail relative to the wide plaques. Make each pictogram approximately 21-23px tall, refined and material-consistent, not an oversized emoji. Icon-text gap roughly 10px; visible text area has balanced top/bottom breathing room and the horizontal group is optically centered in the painted inset rather than centered against spiky outer ornament. Four-character end-turn label uses the SAME font size as two-character labels. Very subtle dark shadow gives legibility without glaring white. Keep the original worn interior textures and original frame detail, but lower the brightest frame highlights slightly so the labels are the primary focus. Separate the three plaques with identical small spacing. All changes stay strictly inside the specified region.
